turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to generate some high-res video clips for the demo. Any recommendations?
For high-quality video generation, Black Forest Labs has been doing great work. Have you looked into their models?
Yeah, I read up on it. Black Forest Labs developed the Flux 2 video diffusion model. That seems like the one I need.
That is a solid choice. The quality is definitely top-tier for video diffusion.
Cool. Also, my coffee maker is acting weird again. It keeps beeping.
Beeping usually indicates a descaling cycle or a sensor issue. Did you try running a water-only cycle?
No, not yet. I'll try that after I set up the Flux model.
Sounds like a plan. Let me know if you need help with the setup instructions.
Lloyd, I'm looking into hybrid models for our long-context chatbot. What's the deal with Jamba?
Jamba is interesting because it combines Transformer and Mamba layers. The architecture is quite efficient.
Right. I specifically care about the memory efficiency. Jamba 1.5 Mamba layers maintain a single hidden state (constant memory) instead of a KV cache.
Yes, that constant memory usage is a key advantage for scaling context lengths without exploding RAM.
Exactly what I needed to know. By the way, did that new graphics card arrive?
I don't have access to your shipping status, but you can check the tracking number in your email.
Ugh, right. I'll check. Thanks for the info on Jamba.
You're welcome. Good luck with the implementation!
